notes.title: PATCH - v0.500
notes.notes:
First of all, sorry about the long delay between updates (more on that later) This patch mostly contains smaller QoL things and preparations for later, but I hope you'll enjoy it :) 
Big thanks as always, the game wouldn't have gotten this far without your support.

[list]
[*]Guest building;
You can left-facebutton a guest to give (or remove) "guest building"privileges. This will allow them to move/delete furniture and to unpack(gift?) present boxes.
Big warning though, this will allow someone to totally mess you place up :) Your room only saves when you "place" a piece of furniture.
Also colour changing furniture is currently broken for guests.

[*]Party palaquin;
The thing that'll take you to the Lord when you've completed all the tracks of the abyss.
Currently doesn't do anything, except move around :)

[*]Bombland go land;
I had code and assets for an unfinished bombman clone prototype laying around so I decided to just add it. 
Is it fun? No idea.

[*]Boxing basement map change;
Curious to see if it works better with smaller sections instead of one big one.

[*]I actually show you your locally saved files now, in a decent menu!

[*]And other small bugfixes.
[/list]

Now here's a few words about the future of sunny-place. Sadly real life work and part time sunny dev isn't working out very well. As you can see by the month long+ update delay, I'm not getting much done. 
I don't want sunny-place to be another game that rots away in EA forever, so I'm going to focus on making a dumb fun ending and release it.

I hope you'll look forward to it, talk to you again soon.

xoxo tjerny
